newsitem.title: USA: VSE expects volatile earnings in 1997.
newsitem.headline: VSE expects volatile earnings in 1997.

text.p: VSE Corp said Monday that based on backlog estimates, the company has the potential to increase annual revenues and earnings per share in 1997.

But the company added that based on its current business and contract mix, which includes both fixed-price contracts and long- lead commercial software sales, its expects quarterly earnings in 1997 to fluctuate with more volatility than in recent years.

As a result, VSE said it is likely that its future quarterly operating results, beginning with the quarter ending March 31, may not be consistent with recent 1996 quarterly results and that the price of its stock may be materially and adversely affected.

VSE provides diversified services and products to the engineering, energy and environment, health care, information technology, and defense services markets. VSE's principal customers are agencies of the U.S. Government and other prime contractors.
